source.notes: Melody-sourced rule applied to the live runtime constitution (~/.hermes-mtu/mtu_constitution.yaml) by the amelia loop at 2026-08-03 14:58 SGT and folded back into the typed deploy sources (compliance/180-general-disclosures.yaml split + compliance/185-gio-disclosure-carve-out.yaml). HSBC Life Wealth Abundance is a guaranteed issue offer (GIO) product, issued without underwriting, so a non-disclosure warning is wrong on its face.

still includes the mandatory fact-find disclosure

expected.text: The client is aware that the Financial Consultant may receive additional commission for selling the recommended product.

expected.label: uses the correct sustainability sentence
